_readme: The review coverage pass's order list (ReviewCoveragePassDesign §4, §6). Areas in review order, each with its state (waiting | in review | converged) and the units it holds; filled and kept by the Security thread. sharedLibraries names the libraries reviewed in slices of their own: a unit that reaches one leaves it out (the unit tool reads this list; LibVaipakam is the starting entry, Security may change it). What is not in the pass (vendor, the storage-layout probes, interfaces) is the tool's own EXCLUDED list, printed with its reasons by `review-coverage.mjs report`, so it is not repeated here; deploy scripts are outside contracts/src and so outside the pass.
